title: Record a training iteration
description: Record one iteration of an open training run. Idempotent on iteration_number — re-sending the same number updates that iteration in place. The recipe is validated server-side: feature_sql in recipe_snapshot must be a read-only SELECT that outputs the anchor key exactly once as a.person_id AS distinct_id, and every events join must be bounded by e.timestamp < fromUnixTimestamp(a.cutoff_ts) and exclude NOT startsWith(e.event, 'autoresearch_'), the model's own prediction events. The validator cannot prove either rule, and without them the features see the outcome window or the model's own past scores, and the holdout AUC is leaked. model_class in model_spec is informational when you upload your own train.py and predict.py bundle; it must be in the sklearn/xgboost allowlist only when the run completes without a bundle. Use status='kept' if the iteration beats the best AUC so far in this run (the first scored iteration is always kept, whatever the current champion scores), 'discarded' otherwise, 'crashed' on failure. Iterations are picked up at completion time to choose the champion. If this iteration was spawned from a pending steering suggestion, pass parent_suggestion = the suggestion's ID — that links the iteration to the suggestion for attribution and marks the suggestion 'acted_on'.

methodDocumentation.text: Record one iteration of an open training run. Idempotent on iteration_number: re-sending the same number updates that iteration. A new iteration_number is refused once the run's iteration_budget is used. The recipe is validated server-side: feature_sql must be a read-only SELECT from {anchors} keyed on person_id, and model_class must be set. The class allowlist applies only at completion, to a run that uploaded no bundle.
